workspace.name: UnityIndie RPG MMO
workspace.note: The workspace root is NOT a git repo. Each repo below is independent.

tiers.fast: Always required for every touched module and every module that depends on it. Cheap, local, deterministic.
tiers.extended: Required when a trigger applies, but expensive or environment-sensitive. Ask the user before running; otherwise report NOT RUN (needs confirmation).
tiers.external: Runs outside this shell (Unity Editor, CI, Docker stack, remote). Ask, or report NOT RUN (external) with the reason.

go.note: go.mod requires go 1.26.x; GOTOOLCHAIN=auto downloads/uses the cached toolchain, so a lower local go is fine unless GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

dotnet.note: WSL usually has only the Windows dotnet.exe. Substitute {dotnet} with the resolved binary.

protoc.note: CI pins protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6. Regenerating with another version drifts the committed headers and fails the proto-generated CI job.

unity-mcp.purpose: Unity Editor MCP (ai-game-developer). Reachable only while the Editor has the client project open. Used to run the Unity Test Runner from an agent.

global_rules.rule: All code, comments, docs, changelogs and commit messages in English.
Current phase is core plumbing only - no gameplay content. If a task would require inventing a gameplay rule (numbers, formulas, content), STOP and ask the user.
Tagging is a release action reserved for the lead. Agents never create tags (v*, sgl-v*, core-baseline-*).
Every change adds an entry under '## [Unreleased]' (Keep a Changelog: Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed/Deprecated/Security) in the CHANGELOG of every touched module.
Update the module docs (README/API/DESIGN/RUNBOOK) before reporting done. New public function or RPC -> API.md entry. Architecture change -> dated DESIGN.md note.
rpg-mmo-server/backend/docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md is authoritative; older docs may be stale. Read the relevant ADR before changing an architectural boundary.
Cross-language contracts change on both sides in the same commit: wire.proto (Go + C# bindings) and the Redis hash servers:id:{id} (C# RedisServerRegistry.cs <-> Go redisstore/registry.go).

A result is evidence only after it passes the verify-a-result checklist: count passes (never infer from absence of failures), prove a zero can be non-zero, name the object measured, write the expected value before measuring.

server.commit_style: Conventional Commits, lowercase scope, squash-merged with (#PR) suffix: fix(gateway): subject (#123)
server.merge: squash; develop -> staging -> main, release-* for production
notes: .claude/ is gitignored in this repo - repo-local skills/agents are never committed here.

client.commit_style: Conventional Commits with scope and (#PR) suffix: chore(packages): bump ... (#141)
notes: Unity 6000.3.9f1. No local test CLI: EditMode/PlayMode tests run in the Unity Test Runner (Editor via MCP) or CI 01-ci.yml.
Packages/com.gdk.* and unity-build-workflows are git submodules. Packages/com.cuvara.* are gitignored embedded clones.
Worktrees are discouraged here: each one needs its own multi-GB Library/ import.

modules.responsibility: Wire protocol source of truth (wire.proto) and its generator.
rules: wire.proto is the only source; never hand-edit generated bindings.
Frames: 4-byte big-endian length prefix + Protobuf; legacy JSON still accepted, told apart by first byte (ADR-9). Fields snake_case.
A wire change updates Go and C# in the same commit and must be proven by the cross-language integration suite.

extended.evidence: Generated diff matches the intended proto change and nothing else. Requires protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6 (CI pin); any other version drifts version headers.

external.run: CI ci.yml job 'Proto bindings up to date' (runs on every PR)
external.evidence: Job conclusion success in gh pr checks.

obligations: Regenerate both bindings with the pinned toolchain and commit them with the .proto change.

modules.responsibility: Foundation Go library: messages, auth, redis store, config. No dependencies on other modules.
rules: shared depends on nothing else in the repo.
Wrap errors fmt.Errorf("ctx: %w", err); table-driven tests beside source; GoDoc on exports; doc.go per package.
Cross-server events use Redis Streams only, never pub/sub (ADR-5).

fast.evidence: Count '--- PASS' / '--- FAIL' / '--- SKIP' lines and 'ok' packages; zero PASS is a failure of the check.

modules.responsibility: Auth + redirect to a game server (returns ServerAddr + JoinToken). Redirector, NOT a proxy (ADR-3).
rules: Gateway never proxies gameplay traffic (ADR-3).

modules.responsibility: Nakama Go runtime plugins: auth, economy, leaderboard, social, matchmaking.

external.run: cd backend/deploy && make plugin (Docker build of the .so plugin against the Nakama image)
external.evidence: Plugin loads in the running Nakama container (logs), not just builds.

modules.responsibility: End-to-end smoke client used post-deploy.
Load generator for capacity measurements.
rules: Measurements follow backend/docs/MEASUREMENT.md and BENCHMARK.md; never quote a player-count ceiling (ADR-7).

modules.responsibility: Deploy verification probe binary. Has NO tests.

fast.evidence: exit 0 (module has no tests; do not report a test count)

modules.responsibility: Pure deterministic C# game logic shared with the Unity client (ADR-10). UPM package com.rpgmmo.shared-gamelogic.
rules: Targets netstandard2.1;net10.0. No Unity/ECS/Arch types, no server code, no reflection. NativeAOT compatible.
Float ops limited to + - * /, comparisons, MathF.Min/Max/Abs/Sqrt. Entities are integer handles. Per-tick paths fill a caller-provided Span<T>; no allocations in hot paths.
Every file needs a Unity .meta file (the client imports this folder as a package).
Behaviour change -> regenerate golden vectors and commit fixtures in the same change.
Release = package.json version bump in the same commit; the sgl-vX.Y.Z tag is created by the lead, never by an agent.

fast.evidence: exit 0 and script output lists files checked

extended.trigger: Intended behaviour change in movement/combat/validation/aoi/snapshot logic
extended.evidence: Fixture diff under GoldenVectors/ explained line by line. Never regenerate to make a failing test pass without an intended behaviour change. WSLENV forwards GOLDEN_REGEN to dotnet.exe (harmless with a Linux dotnet).

external.run: Client CI sgl-pin-check.yml / 02-package-pins.yml after the lead tags sgl-vX.Y.Z
external.evidence: Client pins the new tag in manifest.json AND packages-lock.json.

obligations: Bump package.json version when releasing (no tag).
Golden fixtures committed with the behaviour change.

modules.responsibility: C# .NET 10 authoritative game server: combat, movement, world state, AOI. NativeAOT published.
rules: XML doc comments on public APIs; no allocations in hot paths; NativeAOT-safe (System.Text.Json source generators, no reflection).
Tests needing docker/Postgres/Redis use [SkippableFact] / SkipUnlessAvailable(), never an early return. Deadlines use Stopwatch, not DateTime.UtcNow.
Movement-related changes need a test through the live socket path (pattern: GameServer.Tests/Server/SlowClientMovementTests.cs).
Redis hash servers:id:{id} is a cross-language contract with Go redisstore/registry.go.

fast.evidence: Summary line 'Failed: F, Passed: P, Skipped: S, Total: T' per test project; report all four numbers.
exit 0 - proves the run selected and executed tests (dotnet test exits 0 on zero selected / all skipped).

extended.trigger: New component types, serialization, reflection-adjacent code, or csproj changes
extended.evidence: Publish succeeds with no trim/AOT warnings AND the native binary survives a real join (TestDotnetInterop with GAMESERVER_NATIVE_BIN). A clean publish alone proves nothing (ADR-11 decision 4). Linux native binary requires a Linux dotnet; from WSL with dotnet.exe this produces a Windows binary.

external.run: CI ci-dotnet.yml (every PR to main/master/develop/staging): build, test, counters, AOT publish + native TestDotnetInterop
external.evidence: gh pr checks shows the jobs as pass (count them; an absent check is not a pass).

modules.responsibility: Cross-language E2E: Go gateway + C# game server in one run (TestDotnetInterop*). The only check that proves wire compatibility.
rules: Every test sits behind //go:build integration; without -tags integration the package compiles to zero tests and passes green.

fast.evidence: exit 0 (without the tag vet checks nothing)

extended.trigger: Any change to a wire type, handshake, JoinToken, redirect, or registry contract - or on request
extended.evidence: Count '--- PASS: TestDotnetInterop' lines; the suite builds and launches the C# server, so it needs a working dotnet (dotnet.exe from WSL may not satisfy it).

external.run: CI ci.yml job 'Integration tests / backend/integration_test' (runs on every PR to main/master/develop/staging; verified on run 36089393362: 25 PASS incl. TestDotnetInterop_FullFlow json+proto)
external.evidence: Job pass AND non-zero PASS count in its log.

known_issues.summary: backend/TEAM.md points to a verify-a-result skill in .claude/skills/ of the server repo; it exists only in the client repo (and .claude/ is gitignored in the server repo). Factory Core points to the client copy.

ci-dotnet.yml comments and backend/deploy/docs/CICD.md 'Known gap: wire-compat coverage' say the cross-language E2E suite runs only in cd.yml on push. ci.yml's test-integration job runs it on every PR (verified: PR run 36089393362, 25 PASS incl. TestDotnetInterop_FullFlow). The docs are stale; trust the workflow + run log.
Workspace-root toggle-packages.sh rewrites Packages/manifest.json but not packages-lock.json and writes WSL file: paths. Never commit its output; 02-package-pins would fail.
CI pins protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6; the local WSL protoc may differ (factory-context reports it). Regenerating with a different version drifts headers.
WSL has no Linux dotnet; only Windows dotnet.exe. Build/test work through it; Linux AOT publish and env-var passing (GOLDEN_REGEN) need care (WSLENV).
